definitions.gloss: West Germany; the Federal Republic of Germany (1949–1990)
definitions.explanation: The western of the two German states between the Second World War and reunification in 1990.

examples.japanese: {西|にし}ドイツ⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれ：01867_umare⟧だ。
examples.english: He was born in West Germany.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{西|にし}ドイツ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいた→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: My father lived in West Germany.

examples.japanese: 1990⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{東|ひがし}→東：02250_higashi⟧⟦ドイツ→ドイツ：30813_doitsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{西|にし}ドイツ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{統一|とういつ}→統一：04551_touitsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: East and West Germany were reunified in 1990.

notes:
A historical name, met in history, sport (the West German national football team) and older people's memories. The country today is ⟦ドイツ→ドイツ：30813_doitsu⟧.

- ⟦{東西|とうざい}→東西：04554_touzai⟧⟦ドイツ→ドイツ：30813_doitsu⟧: East and West Germany
